reason: The 3-day trial that bills on day 4 with payments final is exactly the setup I'd expect from something I'd regret, and there are no customer results anywhere, only '7 of 100 seats'. I'm not putting $147 of my own money on a card for a tool nobody has shown works.
objection: Card up front, bills after 3 days, no refunds, and zero published results. Three days isn't enough to see replies from DMs anyway, so I'd be paying before I could know if it works.
would_change_my_mind: A real refund window after the first charge (or a trial that needs no card), plus a few named customers showing replies and booked calls from the DMs.
